title: Implement widget preset load and reuse states
description: Let another Filter Controller widget select, load, link, detach, or import a saved preset without silently overwriting local settings.
objective: Make saved presets reusable across Elementor pages and widget instances while keeping mutation semantics explicit.
expected_outputs: Conflict behavior when local filters already exist
Guilherme QA checklist for editor copy and interaction
acceptance_criteria: A second widget can select a saved preset and render the same filter structure.
Detached import does not silently mutate the saved preset.
Linked preset behavior is explicit if implemented.
Existing local filters are not overwritten without clear user intent.
A missing preset produces a recoverable state instead of a broken widget.
verification: JS syntax checks pass if editor JS changes.
WP-CLI render smoke verifies loaded preset structure.
Generated HTML contract includes expected filters and runtime config.
Guilherme performs frontend/editor QA for interaction nuance.

budgets.context_budget: widget controls, preset resolver, editor copy/state

risks: Linked presets can surprise users if edits mutate shared configuration.
Editor copy must be clear enough to distinguish shared preset from local copy.
